caption: sky note: "mercury retrograde breaks your phone." not true. it starts tuesday, feb 9, at 6° pisces.

slides.headline: “mercury retrograde breaks your phone”
slides.body: nothing about mercury touches your phone. retrograde is how the planet looks from earth, not a force. phones break all year. we just notice in retrograde.

slides.headline: *mercury* doesn't reverse. it laps us
slides.body: mercury circles the sun faster than we do. as it passes us, it seems to slide back: 6° pisces on feb 9 to 20.9° aquarius on mar 3.

slides.headline: a season for *re-dos*: read twice, then reconnect
slides.body: astrologers read mercury as talk and plans. its retrograde reads as time to double-check and finish old conversations before new ones.
